sections.html:
Steel Liner Panels are a great way to finish off your garages, workshops, labs, industrial and commercial spaces with great aesthetics and durable protection. Providing a lifetime finish and an enhancement to any structural design.

  • Stronger and more durable than drywall
  • 3x lighter than drywall
  • 29 gauge steel
  • Easy installation
  • Environmentally Friendly
  • Saves energy and heat loss
  • Available in White and Galvanized

Stellar Metal Roofing offers a wide range of custom-made trims & flashings. Suitable for commercial – industrial, agricultural, and residential applications.
We have the machinery to bend virtually any design of flashing you require up to 10 feet long.

  • Roofing Flashing
  • Deck Flashing
  • Sheds, Gazebos and Pergolas
  • Windows
  • Wall and Building Flashings
  • Deck Flashings
